name: Kineticist
source: Written by Vorthas for Monster Builder for Pathfinder 2e, after Pathfinder GM Core's Class Road Maps ("Building Creatures")
license: GPL-3.0-or-later, like the rest of this app; the Pathfinder rules terms it uses are Paizo's ORC-licensed material.
rules: Low to moderate Perception; high Nature, moderate Stealth; high Con; moderate AC; high to extreme Fortitude, high Reflex, low Will; moderate HP; high accuracy with blasts and moderate damage; high to extreme spell DC (standing in for class DC). Abilities: Two-action Elemental Blast (use Strikes for one-action Elemental Blast, electricity or slashing damage, 60 feet), Channel Elements, +10-foot status bonus to Speed while its kinetic aura is active, Air impulse feats. Junctions: pick one, maybe two, of the element's gate junctions (impulse, aura, critical blast, elemental resistance, skill) for the stat block rather than stacking them all; more is a GM's option for a tougher kineticist

notes.defense: Moderate AC; high to extreme Fortitude, high Reflex, low Will; moderate HP.
notes.offense: High attack bonus with blasts (its spell attack) and moderate damage.
notes.spells: High to extreme spell DC, standing in for its class DC: its impulses work like spells, but it has no spellcasting.
